knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Read archived queryformer-paper-v1 arxiv2609.16548v1 lines58-83; text SHA256f8e114e22e2e8016610748784b98f2ffb59e5611f92ef03689e11f7aed4de3a6. External token-to-query attention/packed-view results concern a different task/capacity regime; local supervised gradient measurements do not show weak forward query construction.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; no new query tokens, attention bridge, capacity or source-task split.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Incoming-gradient routing with identical forward; query-only gradient donation is not QueryFormer query generation.
assessments.falsifier: A separately authorized capacity-matched forward-query replacement would test transfer. These path interventions cannot confirm or refute that architecture.

assessments.rationale: Read archived craft-paper-v1 arxiv2609.01655v1 lines850-914, including AppendixF negative/limited capacity/training findings; text SHA256035e94708a2fd02c4910c7946cd5e8dc2da789983fe95a1aea684d348ea04f68. No local depth/transport instability established. Its external observations do not mandate gates, distillation or longer training.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; no residual transport, reliability gate, distillation, extra depth or optimizer change.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Fixed shallow forward and capacity; isolate product-operand gradients rather than transport information across layers.
assessments.falsifier: Local propagation diagnostics and equal-capacity transport controls would be needed; this study supplies neither and makes no transfer claim.

assessments.rationale: Resolved original record, including negative trajectories, limitations, falsifiers and next-action recommendation. Source export now permits checking actual candidate/training-probe bodies. Cross-seed capability remains absent; respect that limitation. Adapt the next scientific question to a distinct bounded role intervention, not another audit/replay or a donor sweep.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Use its explicit unresolved shared-role/other-path alternative to precommit missing query/history routing factorial cells. Keep existing donor rule and signed local coordination prediction; do not claim cancellation or robustness.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Round14 measured gradients on two training states without changing training rule. This study changes which product operand receives that same rule, without changing forward, loss or optimizer.
assessments.falsifier: Failed isolation or absent/reversed factorial interaction weakens the proposed local coordination explanation; independent-seed uncertainty persists whatever outcome.

assessments.rationale: Resolved full original observations, interpretations, alternatives and falsifiers. Preserve ordering-by-offset reversal, rank-adjacent loss advantage and failed count/action/mean branches. Its rank-half endpoint is inherited, not improved or validated anew by this proposal.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Keep exact inverse-norm rank half-rotation and matched own/full endpoint; vary operand routing only. Use historic controls rather than new donor rules.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Previous donor intervention changed the raw-product VJP for both operands together. New role cells separate them before accumulation into unchanged shared tables.
assessments.falsifier: If only donor semantics or temporal neighborhoods were claimed, current controls would be inadequate; no such claim is made. Failed source/VJP isolation blocks attribution.

assessments.rationale: Read archived v4 primary Eq2 and section4.3 lines240-284. Keep target-aware pooling idea and explicit local masked-softmax/field substitution limitations.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Inheritance only; actual new intervention is two-role surrogate gradient routing in the local product channel.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No published-DIN reproduction or external novelty claim. Masked normalized pooling and the unit aligned product were already local components.
assessments.falsifier: A change to common forward or target pooling would defeat the stated fixed-forward contrast.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.

cards.source_problem: Projection-only queries may insufficiently use field context when retrieving behavior evidence.
cards.reported_mechanism: Attention generates query probes; a field-sequence bridge refines evidence, while packed shared-parameter execution supports multiple views.

reported_evidence.summary: The paper compares query-generation replacements and view scaling. Its development split is not adopted for this task.
reported_evidence.locator: queryformer-paper-v1, section 5.2 Table 4; source split in section 5.1
limitations: The source uses a row-group holdout.
Component removal changes capacity and computation; nearest equal-budget replacement remains necessary.

conditions: target-aware history retrieval is useful on the available fields

transfer_risks: category/brand matching may need less expressive queries
multiple views can increase capacity without validating the query explanation
source task and development distribution differ
possible_discriminating_checks: replace query construction with a capacity-matched projection
separate query quality from view count and shared execution savings
